close_reason:
Implemented email_import(&HashMap<String, EmailImportInput>, Option<&State>) -> EmailImportResponse and email_parse(&[Id], Option<EmailParseParams>) -> EmailParseResponse in crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs.

Added typed input/response structs in methods/mod.rs:
- EmailImportInput<'a> with serde_serialize_with helpers for the {id: true} mailboxIds and {keyword: true} keywords maps required by RFC 8621 §4.8
- EmailImportCreated (per-creation success: id, blob_id, thread_id, size)
- EmailImportResponse (accountId, oldState, newState, created, notCreated)
- EmailParseParams (properties, body_properties, fetch_*, max_body_value_bytes) parallel to EmailGetParams
- EmailParseResponse (accountId, parsed: Option<HashMap<Id, Email>>, notParsable, notFound)

Defence-in-depth guards: empty emails map, empty mailboxIds per creation key, empty blob_ids for parse. ifInState handled when Some.

Updated README:
- Added email_import / email_parse rows to the method table
- Dropped the 'not yet implemented' callout
- Reframed the Known Limitations entry to describe the blob-upload-first dependency rather than missing implementation

cargo fmt + clippy -p jmap-mail-client --tests + test + RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-mail-client --no-deps all green. Workspace clippy/test also green.
description:
Sites: crate-jmap-mail-client/README.md:85 and :186

README currently says: 'Email/import' and 'Email/parse' are not yet implemented as typed methods; callers must use JmapClient::call directly. The README frames this as 'deferred to a future version'.

Bringing into active work. Pattern to follow: any existing typed *_set / *_get method in jmap-mail-client.

After implementation, the README needs updating to drop the 'not yet implemented' section and the 'deferred to a future version' boilerplate.
title: Add typed Email/import and Email/parse method wrappers to jmap-mail-client
